product_metadata.title: Anchor Hocking Heavy Base 12 oz Drinking Glasses, Set of 12
features: INCLUDES: This Anchor Hocking set of drinking glasses contains (12) 12-ounce heavy base tumblers.
DURABLE: This set of glasses is fit for any lunch or dinner. Its weighted design was engineered to prevent spills while its clean, modern shape keeps it always in style.
SAFE: Anchor Hocking drinking glasses are healthier than plastic and metal. Glass is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. Will not stain, retain smells, or leach chemicals into drinks and beverages.
USE: These drinking glasses make perfect wedding gifts, holiday gifts, and birthday gifts. Made for all manner of mixed drinks, juices, iced-teas, water, and more.
Anchor Hocking 12-Pack Heavy Base 12.5-Ounce Beverage Glass
This classic heavy-sham design is perfect for mealtime or as barware
Made in the United States of America
description: Great barware staple or the perfect complement to any dinnerware pattern. Glasses are dishwasher safe. Clear glass construction for casual or formal use. Layers beautifully with a variety of dinnerware and table settings.
